title: KARL MAYER | LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers a wide range of products and services of its sector with the focus on textile machinery building. The business activities are concentrated on the fields of warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation for weaving. KARL MAYER supports the success of its international customers with products and services that are outstanding in both economic and technical terms, as well as with innovations that move the textile world forward. KARL MAYER has employees all over the world. Thanks to its global organization and its claim to produce in its main markets, the company is always close to its customers and their needs. Today, it has subsidiaries in the USA, India, Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, China, Turkey, India and Switzerland, as well as agencies in all parts of the world. KARL MAYER is a German family-owned company, which has focused on financial independence and economic sustainability since its foundation in 1937. As a permanent, reliable partner with decades of experience and a high level of quality in all areas, it supports the competitiveness of its customers and business partners. KARL MAYER opens a new era in textile innovation 🚀. KARL MAYER officially inaugurated its new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER (TIC) in Obertshausen, Germany, bringing together warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation technologies under one roof. The 5,000 m² innovation hub is designed to accelerate textile development from idea to industrialization, offering advanced machinery, collaborative R&D opportunities and hands-on prototyping capabilities. Industry leaders including Karl Josef Mayer, Lutz Wolf and experts from New Balance Athletics highlighted the importance of connected textile innovation and future-oriented textile solutions during the event. title: KARL MAYER opens new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER - Specialty Fabrics Review
content: # KARL MAYER opens new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER. KARL MAYER opened its new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER (TIC) April 21 in Obertshausen, Germany. The company will be hosting an opening week for the center April 21–24, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony scheduled for April 23. “With our TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER, we are strongly focusing on textiles as the heart of our industry and the growth engine for our customers. The center will provide a meeting space for industry members and partners to network, share ideas and learn about new developments in the industry. “The size and equipment of our new TEXTILE INNOVATION CENTER are unrivalled in the world. Here, we are aiming at the Medici effect, basically a renaissance of the textile industry; it’s about preserving and building up textile know-how and textile technology, as well as developing innovative textile solutions,” says Karl Josef Mayer, representative of the Mayer family and patron of the TIC.

title: Karl Mayer: Transformation focused on the future
content: Leading textile machinery group will now focus on core business areas of warp knitting, warp preparation and technical textiles. The Karl Mayer Group has issued the following statement on its future, in light of the recent news that it will exit the flat knitting sector:. In future, the long-established family company will be focusing once again on its core business areas – warp knitting, warp preparation and technical textiles. Karl Mayer is investing in the further development of its machine technologies in its core areas – a measure that takes account of the needs of its customers. The global network of subsidiaries and qualified representatives in over 90 countries guarantees that Karl Mayer will continue to provide its customers with fast and competent support in the future. With this strategic reorientation, the company will continue to rely on its tradition and innovative strength in order to meet the challenges of the global market.
